note: جلد is a major homograph: جلد/jald means soon/quickly, while jild means skin and a book volume/binding. Adverb POS is missing.
proposed_english: soon; quickly; skin; hide; book volume; binding/cover (depending on pronunciation/context)

note: آیا should lead with the extremely common verb form 'came/arrived'; ayah/nurse is a distinct loanword/homograph and should be secondary.
proposed_english: came; arrived (masculine singular perfect of آنا); ayah/nursemaid (noun, context-dependent)

note: کل is a crucial Urdu homograph meaning yesterday or tomorrow depending on context, and کُل means all/total; it can also mean machine/device in another reading. The source's 'bald; dumb' is erroneous/noisy and omits the dominant time meanings.
proposed_english: yesterday; tomorrow; all; total; machine/device (context-dependent)

note: او is an interjection/vocative 'O!/oh!' and can name the Latin letter O. The listed adverb/preposition/pronoun POS tags are incorrect noise.
proposed_english: O!; oh!; the letter O (context-dependent)

note: علاقے is an inflected form of علاقہ and must explicitly give areas/regions/area rather than only inflection labels.
proposed_english: areas; regions; area/region (oblique/vocative singular, context-dependent)

note: کس is the singular oblique interrogative pronoun 'whom/which/of whom etc.', not a noun in its dominant grammatical use.
proposed_english: whom; which; whose/of whom (singular oblique interrogative, context-dependent)

note: بڑھ is the stem/imperative base of بڑھنا meaning increase/grow/advance. 'Content word' is not a POS.
proposed_english: increase; grow; advance (stem/imperative base of بڑھنا)

note: The modern English loan 'car' is written کار and is an A1 Urdu equivalent in Cambridge; the current entry omits this extremely common homograph.
proposed_english: car (English loan); function; duty; use; work; occupation; action; -er/agent-forming element

note: Current one-word gloss omits several central senses.
proposed_english: statement; declaration; description; account; narration; exposition

note: اختیار should teach authority/power/control/choice/discretion/option. 'Imprimatur' is a rare dictionary artifact and should not lead a general learner entry.
proposed_english: authority; power; control; choice; discretion; option

note: Central right/entitlement sense omitted.
proposed_english: right; entitlement/claim; truth; righteousness; portion/share; duty/obligation

note: ماہ very commonly means month in Urdu; the Persian/literary moon/beloved senses are secondary. Omitting 'month' is a major learner defect.
proposed_english: month; moon (literary/Persian-derived); beloved (poetic, context-dependent)

note: رائے centrally means opinion/view/advice and can mean vote. 'King' is a separate title/name reading (Rai/Rae) and should not lead the learner entry.
proposed_english: opinion; view; advice; vote

note: سابق means former/previous/ex-/past. 'Teacher; lecturer' is erroneous source contamination and should be removed.
proposed_english: former; previous; ex-; past

note: اچھی should give the direct learner meaning good/nice/well (feminine) rather than only refer to the masculine dictionary form.
proposed_english: good; nice; well (feminine form of اچھا)

note: جان means life/soul/spirit and is also used affectionately for a dear/beloved person. The current entry is understandable but omits the very common affectionate use.
proposed_english: life; soul; spirit; vitality; dear/beloved (affectionate use)

note: بھائی centrally means brother. The source lists bro/cousin/any male person but inexplicably omits the basic family meaning.
proposed_english: brother; bro; male cousin (context-dependent); male friend/fellow (informal)

note: اندر means inside/in/within and functions primarily as an adverb/noun/postpositional element. Adjective and name POS are dictionary noise here.
proposed_english: inside; in; within; interior

note: طلب means demand/request/requirement as well as desire/yearning. The current gloss is too narrow.
proposed_english: demand; request; desire; yearning; requirement

note: واپس functions primarily as an adverb meaning back/again/returned, not simply an adjective.
proposed_english: back; again; returned; restored

note: سر is the noun head/top and the honorific loan 'sir'. Adjective/adverb POS are unnecessary for the core learner entry.
proposed_english: head; top; sir (honorific)

note: قوم means nation/people/community/ethnic group. 'Race' can be misleading in modern English and should be framed as ethnicity/people rather than biological race.
proposed_english: nation; people; community; ethnic group
